Snapshots in the Console

(Chrome only)

  • 1. Open this page on Google Chrome or Canary
  • 2. Open the Chrome DevTools and Focus to the Console Cmd+Opt+J
  • 3. Click the "Take Shot" button below
  • 4. Allow access to your camera
  • 5. Voilà!

No Stream API

Sorry, this experiment requires the Stream API.
